prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t name a single objectively “best” lawyer — the right attorney depends on your case details and priorities (severity of injuries, whether you want a trial lawyer, language needs, etc.). I can, however, help you find the best match and give guidance on identifying top Miami personal injury lawyers for car-accident cases.

Quick questions so I can tailor recommendations:
- What neighborhood or ZIP code in Miami are you in?
- How serious were your injuries (minor, moderate, severe/permanent)?
- Do you want a trial lawyer or someone who focuses on negotiated settlements?
- Any preferences (Spanish/Creole-speaking, female attorney, budget/fee concerns)?

How to choose the best personal injury lawyer for a Miami car accident
- Experience & focus: Look for lawyers who focus on car-accident and personal-injury law and who handle cases similar to yours (e.g., catastrophic injury, wrongful death).
- Track record: Ask about past settlements/verdicts in similar cases and whether they have trial experience.
- Reputation & credentials: Check peer ratings (Martindale-Hubbell), local recognition (Super Lawyers), and client reviews.
- Communication: Confirm who will handle your case day-to-day and how often you’ll get updates.
- Fees & costs: Most PI lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless they recover money). Ask the contingency percentage and which costs (experts, filing fees) you’ll owe if you don’t recover.
- Availability & resources: Larger firms may have investigators/medical experts; boutique firms may offer more personal attention.
- Discipline check: Verify license and disciplinary history with the Florida Bar (www.floridabar.org).

Where to look / verify attorneys
- Florida Bar Lawyer Directory (for license and disciplinary history)
- SuperLawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo (ratings/interviews)
- Google and Yelp reviews, plus local news (verdicts/settlements)
- Personal referrals from friends/family

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- How many car-accident PI cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- What is your estimated value range for my case and why?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your contingency fee and who pays case costs?
- How long do you expect this case to take?
- Can you provide references or past client outcomes (anonymized)?

Important legal points
- Florida statute of limitations for most personal-injury claims is 4 years from the accident (Florida Statutes §95.11). Contact a lawyer promptly — evidence and witnesses degrade over time.
- Preserve evidence: photos, medical records, police report, contact info for witnesses.

If you want, I can:
- Suggest several well-regarded Miami personal-injury attorneys/firms (if you want names, tell me your ZIP or neighborhood so I can tailor suggestions based on location and your needs).
- Draft a short script/email you can use to contact firms for initial consultations.
- Review any attorney names you’ve already found and help compare them.

Which would you like to do next?
